info.title: Report System API
info.description: API documentation for the report system backend. Most school-scoped endpoints require an owner Sanctum token with the `permit:owner` ability.

post.description: Authenticate a client and return a Sanctum token.

get.description: Returns the currently authenticated client with their schools.

post.description: Revokes the current Sanctum personal access token.
Emails a password reset link when the client email exists.
Resets the client password using a valid reset token and revokes existing tokens.

put.description: Updates the authenticated owner's school. Requires owner ability.
Updates the authenticated student's profile. Requires student ability.
Updates the authenticated teacher's profile. Requires teacher ability.

post.description: Creates an owner client and their school, then returns a Sanctum token.

post.summary: Add subjects to a class menu
Assign a teacher to subjects in a class

get.summary: List students with pending class marks
get.description: Students who take the subject in the class and term but have no class-score contribution, or a contribution of 0. Marks with closeClassScoreEntry true are excluded. Requires schoolClassId, subjectId, and termId.

get.summary: List students with recorded class marks
get.description: Students whose class-score contribution is greater than 0 and closeClassScoreEntry is false.

post.description: Sets closeClassScoreEntry to true for all matching marks. Closed marks are excluded from pending and recorded class-mark lists. Requires schoolClassId, subjectId, and termId.
Enter continuous assessment scores. Exam score is stored as 0 until exam marks are submitted. Required class fields depend on the school scoring mode.

total_score.summary: Payload when scoring mode is total_score

division_score.summary: Payload when scoring mode is division_score

put.description: Updates continuous assessment scores without changing the exam score.

total_score.summary: Payload when scoring mode is total_score

division_score.summary: Payload when scoring mode is division_score

get.summary: List students with pending exam marks
get.description: Students who take the subject in the class and term but have no exam score, or an exam score of 0. Marks with closeExamScoreEntry true are excluded. Requires schoolClassId, subjectId, and termId.

get.summary: List students with recorded exam marks
get.description: Students whose exam score is greater than 0 and closeExamScoreEntry is false.

post.description: Sets closeExamScoreEntry to true for all matching marks. Closed marks are excluded from pending and recorded exam-mark lists. Requires schoolClassId, subjectId, and termId.

put.summary: Create or update an exam mark
put.description: Updates the exam score when a class mark already exists for the student, subject, and term. Creates the mark with class scores of 0 if it does not exist. participated is required; examScore is required when participated is true. When participated is false, grade is stored as null.

total_score.summary: Payload when scoring mode is total_score

division_score.summary: Payload when scoring mode is division_score

get.description: Returns the school scoring setup. Creates default total-score settings if none exist.

put.description: Updates the active scoring mode and both total-score and division-score configurations. divisionTotal and divisionTotalPercent are derived by the backend.

post.summary: Enroll a student in a class
post.description: Creates an active enrollment and auto-assigns mandatory class subjects.

get.summary: List student subjects for an enrollment

post.summary: Assign elective subjects to a student enrollment
post.description: Adds elective (non-mandatory) subjects to an active enrollment.

classScore.description: Must not exceed classScorePercent on the active mark setting.
Must not exceed classScoreMax on the active mark setting.

homeAssignmentScore.description: Must not exceed homeAssignmentMax on the active mark setting.

projectScore.description: Must not exceed projectMax on the active mark setting.

classTestScore.description: Must not exceed classTestMax on the active mark setting.

examScore.description: Exam score out of 100. Required when participated is true.
Exam score out of 100. Required when participated is true.
